public_rationale: The recall record supports Marcus's point that autonomous-driving errors persisted years after 2016. The compound claim remains unresolved because the approximately $100 billion investment figure has not been matched to his period or a defined financial measure. The $75 billion expenditure estimate is not a valid contradiction because it measures something different.
limitations: Several potentially relevant investment sources could not be read.
One documented error does not establish a general failure rate or absence of technical progress.
The unspecified financial basis prevents a supported or contradicted financial assessment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Despite seven years and roughly $100 billion of investment since 2016, driverless cars' errors have not gone away.

statement.excerpt: Seven years and roughly $100 billion later, those pesky errors haven’t gone away.
statement.document_title: Oops! How Google bombed, while doing pretty much exactly the same thing as Microsoft did, with similar results

from_speaker: those pesky errors haven’t gone away
our_interpretation: The claim combines persistent autonomous-driving errors with approximately $100 billion invested during the intervening period.
The period runs from 2016 through February 8, 2023, the present day identified in the post.
Persistence means that material driving errors still occurred, not that systems made no progress or that every earlier defect remained.
No company, investment dataset, spending definition, or accounting basis is identified.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records establish continuing autonomous-driving errors near the end of the period, and a comparable industry estimate establishes roughly $100 billion invested since 2016.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes that relevant errors had been eliminated, or that investment over the stated period was materially inconsistent with roughly $100 billion.

It supports persistence of errors during the claimed period, while noting that the other vehicle bore most fault and this particular problem was remedied.
